observations.notes: Fitch notes ADM Elektrik generates average annual EBITDA of ~$180m across its Aydın/Denizli/Muğla concession (~2.4m customers, 5.5-6.0% technical losses). Issued $500m 9.50% Feb-31 notes (XS3260262988) in early 2026 to refinance bank debt and fund 5th regulatory period (2026-2030) capex.

recovery_analysis.thesis: ADM Elektrik operates a fully regulated RAB concession in southwest Turkey (~$180m EBITDA, 5.5-6.0% losses) under EMRA's 5th Regulatory Period (2026-2030, real WACC lifted to 13.49%, +40% real capex allowance). Early-26 $500m 9.50% Feb-31 bond (XS3260262988) cleared bank debt, though USD debt vs TRY cash flows remains a structural FX risk. Structural recovery anchored by Turkey utilities asset perimeter and ADMTR 9.50% Feb 2031 ($500m, XS3260262988) seniority.

annotations.note: Fitch assigned BB- Stable; average EBITDA ~$180m; $500m 9.50% Feb-31 notes (XS3260262988); EMRA 2026-30 real WACC 13.49%.
Issued $500m 9.50% senior unsecured notes due Feb 2031 (XS3260262988); Fitch assigned BB- IDR; EMRA 5th regulatory period (2026-2030) lifted real WACC to 13.5%.
Revenues secured by long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or regulated tariff frameworks, providing hard-currency indexation and guaranteed minimum volume off-take.
Heavy generation transition capex peaks in 2024-2025; multi-year FCF inflects strongly positive as commercial operations commence.
Strategic national utility champions benefit from government balancing accounts or explicit fuel supply guarantees, mitigating commodity price volatility.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Regulated Turkish Electricity Distributor (BB- Stable)
verdict.summary: ADM Elektrik operates a fully regulated RAB concession in southwest Turkey (~$180m EBITDA, 5.5-6.0% losses) under EMRA's 5th Regulatory Period (2026-2030, real WACC lifted to 13.49%, +40% real capex allowance). Early-26 $500m 9.50% Feb-31 bond (XS3260262988) cleared bank debt, though USD debt vs TRY cash flows remains a structural FX risk.

positives: Monopolistic electricity distribution concession across Aydın, Denizli, and Muğla under EMRA tariff framework.
5th EMRA regulatory period (2026-2030) lifted real WACC to 13.5% with higher allowed capex and RAB indexation.
Feb 2026 $500m 9.50% 2031 Eurobond (Euronext Dublin, XS3260262988) cleared near-term maturities and diversified funding.
negatives: FX mismatch between USD Eurobond liabilities and TRY-denominated regulated tariffs (partially mitigated by CPI/FX RAB resets).
Heavy grid modernization capex across 2026-2030 limits near-term free cash flow generation.
Parent group (Aydem Holding) cross-portfolio leverage and sister utility/generation capex demands.
